name: Analyze specific topics in environmental sustainability
description: Users requested detailed explanations, analyses, and overviews regarding specific environmental topics, including resource management, pollution mitigation, sustainable practices, and the impacts of human activities on ecosystems. These requests focused on professional, technical, or regulatory aspects such as waste treatment, energy efficiency, organizational sustainability standards, and agricultural environmental impacts.
